scope: Research simulator fixes and checker hardening. No live order code, fee changes, model tuning, cache deletion, or forward-day reads. This is implementation verification, not profitability validation.

changes.details: Client-visible cancellation reservations are stored independently of physical fillable orders. They release on observable cancellation/rejection/fill acknowledgements; cancel-pending creates are carried through activation by stable object identity. Throttling never counts hidden physical remaining quantity in the known policy view. The explicit physical regression mode preserves the falsifier.
Loss-cap decisions use notified cash/inventory, pending placements and client-visible open/cancel-pending quantities. Matching accounting still uses physical fills.

Checker validates summary/day/arm identities; complete matching fills, requests, and window artifacts; manifest counts; window cohorts; event references, lane/status/time validity and positive finite delays. Missing/empty/mismatched inputs return REFUSED (exit 2). Valid zero-fill known arms are accepted as observations only when complete.

verification.loop: repair -> check -> review -> repair fixture -> check -> integration smoke

attempts.reason: Own-cross fixture reached venue-book rejection before the intended branch; corrected the fixture, with no relaxation of assertions.
Final engine changes include terminal rejection reservation release.

targeted.description: Both engine sources, both sides, partial/full fills, varied message spacing and fill-notification delays; paired whole request streams; loss-cap/sequential variants; live/ladder base parity; all earlier positive/regression controls; 12 malformed/missing artifact cases and invalid-delay refusals.

integration.scope: integration smoke only, not performance evaluation

read_record.selection: First eight windows for integration mechanics only; this day was already consumed. Binance padding uses other already-read adjacent hours. No sealed or forward day read.

limitations: No historical profitability or full parameter-grid rerun was performed; prior economics are not automatically revalidated by these code checks.
Causality suite targets the active split-latency known-policy configuration; explicit legacy physical mode remains intentionally noncausal as a falsifier.
Replay fill timing/queue assumptions and own market impact remain calibration limits.
